added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed run's manifest declares neither a baseline_suite nor an after_suite arm, so no added-failure count can be derived from its own gate logs; 0 with an empty id list is recorded because the delivery contract refuses a null, and it denotes that no suite arm was run rather than a measured zero.

findings.text: No assertion anywhere binds produced >= CAP_FLOOR to an exit status: `short = CAP_FLOOR - summary["produced"]` becomes the display string `floor_note`, and readback() returns 0 unconditionally, so the gate the manifest names (drive.sh readback approval) exits green on a read-back of 99 of 143. A regression in source_state that dropped bindings would be caught by the plant, but a genuine shortfall would not be caught by the gate at all.
A duplicated `if outcome.get("after_status") == "vocab_gap": pass` sits immediately above the branch that does the work, leaving a dead no-op statement in _reason().

When a source carries any recorded error text, _reason() returns that text alone and never appends the attempt count or the reset receipt id. Rows such as dd:camera_ir/fibre_bundle/geometry/x1_width therefore read only `compose claim-attempt cap reached`, carrying no receipt and no count, which is thinner than the done_when's requirement that every other source read back 'with its reason and receipts'.

plant() creates its scratch directory with tempfile.mkdtemp and never removes it; stop_temp_neo4j stops the process group only, so the tree the run's own sbatch-cleanup.log records as `2.3M /tmp/sfdc-plant-bli6yp_m` is left on the compute node for an external sweep.

The module docstring says only the cohort path, the artifact home and the negative control are new, but approval(), _reason() and fragment() are also added, and _reason() and fragment() restate the prior module's functions of the same name rather than extending them.
